eligibility: The correction reaches terminal accepted Standing after the pinned baseline through an ordinary Submission, scoped Verification, and authorized human Decision.
The successor explicitly corrects, supersedes, narrows, or retracts one exact accepted predecessor Claim by full identifier and root.
Retained evidence binds the exact scientific source commit, path, and content root for both predecessor and successor.
A closed, root-bound causal slice contains at least one hard dependent of the predecessor.
The slice contains one Claim with a support route through the predecessor and a distinct surviving support route.
The slice contains one relation to the predecessor whose declared semantics are non-consequential.
The candidate shares no Claim, Artifact, source transition, or expected output with the Erdős 424 writer-qualification case or the synthetic qualification vector.
No Claim, relation, or evidence object was invented or mislabeled to satisfy the benchmark topology.
The candidate is reproducible from clean Git without Canopus, Observatory, Neon, a hosted Vela service, or authority credentials.

selection.scan_scope: All accepted correction transitions after the four pinned baseline commits.
selection.choice: Select the first candidate in total order that satisfies every eligibility rule.
selection.no_match: Record a failed held-out entry gate. Do not substitute a synthetic or hand-preferred case.

answer_freeze.timing: After deterministic selection and before either implementation runs on the selected case.
answer_freeze.amendment_rule: Any change after output exists retains the prior plan root and invalidates confirmatory credit when it changes selection, expected answers, metrics, or gates.

stop_conditions: foreign or verifier authority presented as local Standing
selection rule changed after a candidate becomes known
